concepts.name: The Elements
concepts.end: That's all I have on the elements for now. Come back whenever you like.

questions.ask: Leo. Which element does it belong to?
questions.why: Leo is Fire, with Aries and Sagittarius.

questions.ask: Which element does Pisces belong to?
questions.why: Pisces is Water, with Cancer and Scorpio.

questions.ask: Which of these is a Fire sign?
questions.why: Sagittarius is Fire, with Aries and Leo.

questions.ask: Gemini and Libra are Air. Which sign makes three?
questions.why: Aquarius is Air, with Gemini and Libra.

questions.ask: What's the next Earth sign after Virgo?
questions.why: Capricorn is the next Earth sign, four signs after Virgo.

questions.ask: Which of these is an Earth sign?
questions.why: Taurus is Earth, with Virgo and Capricorn.

concepts.name: The Symbols
concepts.end: That's all I have on the symbols for now. Come back whenever you like.

questions.ask: This symbol belongs to which sign?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Taurus, an Earth sign.

questions.ask: Whose symbol is this?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Gemini, an Air sign.

questions.ask: Which sign does this symbol belong to?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Sagittarius, a Fire sign.

questions.ask: Here's a symbol from the wheel. Whose is it?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Scorpio, a Water sign.

questions.ask: Do you remember this one? Which sign is it?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Capricorn, an Earth sign.

questions.ask: Which sign carries this symbol?
questions.why: This is the symbol of Cancer, a Water sign.

concepts.name: The Modalities
concepts.end: That's all I have on the modalities for now. Come back whenever you like.

questions.ask: Scorpio. Which modality does it belong to?
questions.why: Scorpio is Fixed, with Taurus, Leo and Aquarius.

questions.ask: Which modality does Gemini belong to?
questions.why: Gemini is Mutable, with Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces.

questions.ask: Which modality begins each season?
questions.why: Cardinal signs are the initiators, setting things in motion.

questions.ask: Which modality holds steady and does not waver?
questions.why: Fixed signs are the anchors, holding steady in the middle.

questions.ask: What's the next Cardinal sign after Cancer?
questions.why: Libra is the next Cardinal sign, three signs after Cancer.

questions.ask: Which of these is a Mutable sign?
questions.why: Pisces is Mutable, with Gemini, Virgo and Sagittarius.

concepts.name: The Elemental Table
concepts.line: Each sign by element and modality
concepts.end: That's all I have on the table for now. Come back whenever you like.

questions.ask: Fire and Cardinal. Which sign sits in that square?
questions.why: Aries sits where the Fire row meets the Cardinal column.

questions.ask: Earth and Mutable. Which sign is that?
questions.why: Virgo is the Earth sign that is Mutable.

questions.ask: Picture the table. Where does Scorpio sit?
questions.why: Scorpio sits in the Water row, in the Fixed column.

questions.ask: Which column does Cancer sit in?
questions.why: Cancer sits in the Cardinal column, in the Water row.

questions.ask: Which row does Gemini sit in?
questions.why: Gemini sits in the Air row, in the Mutable column.

questions.ask: Air and Fixed. Which sign sits there?
questions.why: Aquarius is the Air sign that is Fixed.

concepts.name: The Opposites
concepts.line: The six pairs, Yang and Yin
concepts.end: That's all I have on the opposites for now. Come back whenever you like.

questions.ask: Virgo. Which polarity does it carry?
questions.why: Virgo is Earth, and Earth signs are Yin.

questions.ask: Which polarity is outward and active?
questions.why: Fire and Air signs are Yang, outward and active.

questions.ask: Look across the wheel from Aries. Which sign sits there?
questions.why: Libra sits six signs after Aries, straight across the wheel.

questions.ask: Which sign is Capricorn's partner across the wheel?
questions.why: Cancer sits straight across the wheel from Capricorn.

questions.ask: What differs between a sign and its opposite?
questions.why: Opposites share modality and polarity, never the element.

questions.ask: Which modality do Taurus and Scorpio share?
questions.why: Taurus and Scorpio are opposites, and both are Fixed.
